remarks: No showings until 4/9/26 6pm..keybox not on yet!!What a great, convenient rental apartment! Walk to Rowayton train station (1 mile), to Brookside Elementary School (0.2 mile), to Brien McMahon High School (0.1 mile) and to South Norwalk...also about 1 mile. Spotlessly clean, 2BR, 1.5 bath half-duplex in excellent condition. New vinyl plank floors in kitchen and baths. Freshly painted. One bill takes care of heat, hot water, cooking and lights. Landlord takes care of water, sewer, trash, lawn maintenance and plowing of the driveway (you still need to shovel your steps and clear your car, but that is it for maintenance). No pets please. Two parking spaces closest to house on right are the spaces that go with the unit. Some lawn in back, property mostly fenced.

facts.laundryLoc: in closet near half bath. New stackable.
